Land Titles (Strata) Act
(Chapter 158)
Land Titles (Strata) (Variation of Initial Period) Regulations 1996
In exercise of the powers conferred by the definition of “initial period” in section 3 and by section 130 of the Land Titles (Strata) Act, the Minister for Law hereby makes the following Regulations:
